reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Chelsea McCully
reviews.text: I’ve had to use James twice now and I’m always pleased with his work, timeliness, manners, but most importantly his honesty. At no point have I ever felt he was taking advantage of his position as an expert and his prices are more than fair. Yesterday he was able to stop by because his last job finished early. The problem I thought I had was much more minor than expected and he was able to fix two problems in the course of about 20 minutes. Most companies would charge a standard house call charge and that would be added into the total cost of the visit. James was exceptionally fair in his price. I recommend him to anyone who needs a trustworthy plumber!

reviews.author: Bryan P
reviews.text: We have used James twice now, once for a fill value connection toilet leak and Water Heater check-up and once for a garbage disposal install. Very friendly and knowledgeable. He took the time to walk me through the water heater to explain the ins and outs of the life expectancy of the different components. Garbage disposal is issue free after six months.

reviews.author: bossybakenman liver
reviews.text: Mr. James provided outstanding plumbing service. Honest, polite, reliable & knowledgeable. He accommodated us in his schedule under 24hrs. Provided a diagnostic via phone and gave us options on how to handle the issue. We had an inoperative pressure balance cartridge for our shower. He linked us with a local vendor to acquire the needed part; saving us money. Normally, companies would add an up-charge for the parts if they provide the part. He took care of us on that. The repair were completed seamless and he also provided us with an inside look with pointers of the job for future reference. Outstanding and quick service and generous price. Family owned company with an amazing owner. Thank you Mr. James. We are very pleased with the service. We strongly recommend.
